lines.en: label day50:
scene dayfifty1
Another[school] day gets off to a relatively mild-mannered start.
lines.zh: 又一天的[school]生活，以相对温和的方式开始了。

lines.en: I don’t feel like doing anything today, so I told the girls they can just do whatever it is they want.
lines.zh: 我今天什么都不想干，所以跟女孩们说，她们想干什么就干什么。

lines.en: "Of course, Makoto was opposed to the idea and has, per usual, gone back to studying like the success-driven
lines.zh: 「当然，Makoto 反对这个主意，而且一如既往地又回去学习了，就像她那个被成功驱动的

lines.en: prefect she is."
lines.zh: 风纪委员该有的样子。」

lines.en: Ami and Maya are chatting, Chika is on her phone, Futaba is reading...
lines.zh: Ami 和 Maya 在聊天，Chika 在玩手机，Futaba 在看书……

lines.en: Ayane is...staring directly at me...
lines.zh: Ayane 在……直勾勾地盯着我……

lines.en: Yup. Pretty much everything looks normal today.
lines.zh: 嗯。今天看起来一切都挺正常的。

lines.en: Well, almost everything...
lines.zh: 嗯，几乎一切都……

lines.en: scene dayfifty2
: Huh...Rin’s not here again...
lines.zh: : 咦……Rin 又不在啊……

lines.en: Normally, I wouldn’t think anything of it if one of the girls were to miss a class or two.
lines.zh: 正常情况下，如果有哪个女孩缺一两节课，我不会多想。

lines.en: "But Rin’s been starting to miss a lot lately. And I know she told me not to
lines.zh: 「但 Rin 最近开始缺得越来越多。我知道她让我别

lines.en: worry but I can’t help wondering if she’s really doing okay."
lines.zh: 担心，可我忍不住想知道她是不是真的还好。」

lines.en: Maybe Futaba knows something?
lines.zh: 也许 Futaba 知道些什么？

lines.en: : Hey, Futaba...
lines.zh: : 嘿，Futaba……

lines.en: scene dayfifty3
: Sensei? Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : 老师？出什么事了吗？

lines.en: : You don’t normally visit me at my desk...
lines.zh: : 你平时不会到我座位这边来的……

lines.en: : I was actually just wondering if you knew anything about why Rin’s been absent so much lately.
lines.zh: : 我其实只是想知道，你知不知道 Rin 最近为什么总是不在。

lines.en: scene dayfifty4
: Are you worried about her?
lines.zh: : 你在担心她吗？

lines.en: : Of course I am. Just like I’d be worried about you if you started going missing all the time.
lines.zh: : 当然担心。就像如果你也开始动不动就消失，我也会担心你一样。

lines.en: scene dayfifty5
: Well, uhh...I mean, I kind of know...I just don’t know if she’d be happy with me telling you or not.
lines.zh: : 嗯……呃……我是说，我大概知道一点……我只是不确定她会不会乐意我说给你听。

lines.en: scene dayfifty6
f "She’s, umm...Well, she’s not really in the best state of mind right now. That’s
lines.zh: f 「她，嗯……怎么说呢，她现在精神状态不太好。这

lines.en: probably the easiest way to put it."
lines.zh: 大概是最简单的说法了。」

lines.en: "Huh...She did say all that stuff about ‘thinking things she wasn’t
lines.zh: 「嗯……她确实说过那些关于『在想不该想的东西』之类的话，

lines.en: supposed to,’ or however it was she put it."
lines.zh: 或者不管她当时是怎么说的。」

lines.en: I’m assuming that’s what Futaba is talking about here.
lines.zh: 我猜 Futaba 说的就是这个。

lines.en: : Is there like...something wrong with her?
lines.zh: : 她是……有什么问题吗？

lines.en: scene dayfifty7
: Sensei! That’s a horrible way to word that question! Of course nothing’s wrong with her...
lines.zh: : 老师！这问题问得太难听了！她当然没有什么问题……

lines.en: : Oh, I didn’t mean anything bad by that. You’re right. It was poor phrasing.
lines.zh: : 哦，我没有恶意。你说得对，是我措辞不当。

lines.en: : What I’m trying to ask is if she needs our help or medical help or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 我想问的是，她需不需要我们的帮助，或者医疗上的帮助之类的。

lines.en: : I don’t really know what to do in situations like these.
lines.zh: : 我真的不知道遇到这种情况该怎么办。

lines.en: scene dayfifty5
: Well...I guess that can’t really be helped.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那大概也是没办法的事。

lines.en: : I never really knew what to do until recently either. It’s not exactly something that[school] prepares you for.
lines.zh: : 我自己也是到最近才知道该怎么办。这本来就不是[school]会教你的东西。

lines.en: : How long have you two known each other again?
lines.zh: : 你们两个是什么时候认识的来着？

lines.en: scene dayfifty8
: Oh jeez, I can’t even remember. I think since elementary[school]?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，我都记不清了。大概从小学[school]开始？

lines.en: : What I do remember is that she was the one to approach me first.
lines.zh: : 我只记得是她先来找我搭话的。

lines.en: scene dayfifty9
: I wasn’t really the best at making friends, and I guess she just realized that before everyone else.
lines.zh: : 我那时不太擅长交朋友，大概是她比别人先注意到了这一点。

lines.en: That definitely sounds like the Rin I know...Weirdly outgoing and always thinking about other people.
lines.zh: 这确实像我认识的那个 Rin……异常地主动，总是替别人着想。

lines.en: "After all, this is the same person who’s still actively trying to set me up with her roommate just because
lines.zh: 「毕竟，就是这个人到现在还在积极地把我和她的室友往一起撮合，

lines.en: she thinks it will make both of us happy."
lines.zh: 只因为她觉得那样我们两个都会幸福。」

lines.en: It’s weird thinking that she’s hiding some sort of other life behind all of that.
lines.zh: 想到她在那一切面具背后还藏着某种别的生活，感觉挺奇怪的。

lines.en: scene dayfifty8
: She wasn’t always like this, though...
lines.zh: : 不过她也不一直是这样……

lines.en: scene dayfifty9
: Well, I guess that’s not entirely accurate.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想那也不完全准确。

lines.en: : I guess it’s more of an ‘it’s never been that serious’ kind of thing...
lines.zh: : 我觉得更像是「从来没这么严重过」……

lines.en: scene dayfifty8
: Normally, she gets better after a day or two. Sometimes even a few hours.
lines.zh: : 正常情况下，她过一两天就好了。有时候甚至几个小时。

lines.en: scene dayfifty10
: But...
lines.zh: : 但是……

lines.en: Futaba’s smile is suddenly wiped off of her face as she comes to terms with how unusual her current situation is.
lines.zh: Futaba 脸上的笑容突然消失了，她终于意识到当下的情况有多反常。

lines.en: : I feel like she’s barely even been getting out of bed lately...
lines.zh: : 我觉得她最近连床都几乎起不来了……

lines.en: : I’m kind of worried about leaving her alone, actually...
lines.zh: : 说实话，我有点不敢把她一个人留下……

lines.en: : You don’t think she’d do anything...stupid, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不会觉得她会做……什么傻事吧？

lines.en: scene dayfifty11
: Not at all. She’d never do anything like that.
lines.zh: : 绝对不会。她绝不会做那种事。

lines.en: f "She might be going through some stuff right now, but I know that deep down, she
lines.zh: f 「她现在也许正在经历一些事，但我知道她内心深处

lines.en: loves pretty much everyone and everything."
lines.zh: 爱着几乎所有的人和事。」

lines.en: : I thought the same thing.
lines.zh: : 我也是这么想的。

lines.en: s "I mean, obviously you know her much better than I do, but I’m pretty
lines.zh: s 「我的意思是，显然你比我更了解她，但我很

lines.en: sure she’ll pull through whatever it is that’s going on."
lines.zh: 确定她会挺过去的，不管现在到底发生了什么。」

lines.en: scene dayfifty8
if futaba_love > 9:
: I knew you’d agree with me there. That’s just the kind of person you are, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我就知道你会同意我的看法。你就是这种人，老师……

lines.en: : You might try to hide it, but I can tell how much you care about all of us...
lines.zh: : 你也许想藏着掖着，但我看得出来你有多在乎我们所有人……

lines.en: : Plus, Rin’s been saying a lot of nice things about you lately.
lines.zh: : 而且 Rin 最近说了不少关于你的好话。

lines.en: scene dayfifty12
: I’m actually...kind of jealous she’s been seeing you so much...hahaha...
lines.zh: : 说实话……我还有点嫉妒她能经常见到你呢……哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Really? What has she been saying?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？她都说了些什么？

lines.en: else:
: I had a feeling you’d agree with me.
lines.zh: : 我就知道你会同意我的看法。

lines.en: : Rin’s been saying nothing but nice things about you lately.
lines.zh: : Rin 最近说起你的时候，净是些好话。

lines.en: : Really? Like what?
lines.zh: : 真的？比如？

lines.en: scene dayfifty8
: Just things about how you’re really cool for your age and that you’re fun to be around...stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 就是说你以你这个年纪来说真的很酷啊、和你在一起很开心啊……之类的。

lines.en: Huh...I had no idea Rin would actually be talking about me to other people.
lines.zh: 嗯……我完全不知道 Rin 居然会跟别人聊起我。

lines.en: I mean, it is her roommate, though, so I'm sure it just randomly came up in conversation once or twice.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，那毕竟是她的室友，所以我猜只是闲聊时碰巧提过一两次。

lines.en: I shouldn’t get too excited about that.
lines.zh: 我不该为此太兴奋。

lines.en: : Well that’s really nice of her. Whenever I make friends my age, I’ll be sure to tell them about her as well.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她人真好。等哪天我交到同龄的朋友，我一定也会跟他们提起她的。

lines.en: : Heheh~ Are you sure that’s the best idea?
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~你确定那是个好主意吗？

lines.en: : Actually, no. I’m sure that would be a horrible idea.
lines.zh: : 其实不确定。我敢说那肯定是个糟透了的主意。

lines.en: : But either way, do you think there’s anything I can do for her?
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，你觉得我能为她做点什么吗？

lines.en: scene dayfifty4
: For Rin?
lines.zh: : 为 Rin 吗？

lines.en: : I mean...I don’t think she wants to see anyone right now but...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我觉得她现在谁都不想见，但是……

lines.en: scene dayfifty8
: Maybe you could try writing her a letter?
lines.zh: : 也许你可以试着给她写封信？

lines.en: : A letter?
f "Yeah. You know how powerful words can be. I’m sure that a nice letter or a present
lines.zh: f 「对。你知道文字的力量有多强大。我相信一封暖心的信、

lines.en: or something would make her feel a little better."
lines.zh: 或者一件礼物什么的，会让她好受一点。」

lines.en: : I know it would for me, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少换成我，肯定会。

lines.en: : Huh...
: Yeah, I think I can do that. Hold on one sec.
lines.zh: : 好，我觉得我能做到。稍等一下。

lines.en: scene black
I walk back to my desk and start scribbling down whatever words come to mind.
lines.zh: 我走回自己的桌子前，开始把脑子里冒出来的话胡乱写下来。

lines.en: I finish within a matter of minutes. It’s actually surprisingly easy writing something like this for her.
lines.zh: 几分钟就写完了。说实话，给她写这种东西居然这么容易。

lines.en: Here’s hoping she likes it...
lines.zh: 希望她会喜欢吧……

lines.en: scene dayfifty8
: Done already?
lines.zh: : 已经写好了？

lines.en: : Yup. You’ve gotta promise not to read it, though, okay?
lines.zh: : 嗯。不过你得保证不看，好吗？

lines.en: : And let me know what she says once she sees it.
lines.zh: : 还有，她看到之后说了什么，记得告诉我。

lines.en: : I’m sure she’ll be able to let you know herself soon enough, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我相信她很快就能亲自告诉你了，老师。

lines.en: : Even better. Thanks, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 那更好。谢了，Futaba。

lines.en: : Of course. Thank you for caring enough to ask, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 不客气。谢谢你愿意关心到开口来问，老师……

lines.en: : I’m sure that will mean a lot to her.
lines.zh: : 我相信那对她来说会很重要。

lines.en: scene black
The rest of the class carries on as normal...
lines.zh: 剩下的课照常进行……

lines.en: $ day50 = True
jump afterschoolevent
